stemMd: An integer n leaves remainder 5 when divided by 7. What remainder does n squared leave when divided by 7?
explanationMd: Write n=7k+5. Squaring gives terms divisible by 7 plus 25, and 25 leaves remainder 4. The result does not depend on k.
